edits.new: Check independently required conditions separately, even when they appear in one phrase. For each required role, purpose or intended consumer, vary that condition alone while preserving the child's defining kind or activity and all its other restrictions. Test whether the resulting information remains admitted by the child under the topic rules above.
edits.old: For each purpose or role required by the parent, test whether it can differ or be absent while the information remains admitted by the child's whole fixed meaning under the topic rules above.
